finfr.desc: Termes clés des marchés, de la comptabilité et de l'économie — utiles pour le CFA.

cards.d: A resource with economic value owned or controlled by an entity.
A present obligation of an entity to transfer economic resources.
The residual interest in the assets of an entity after deducting liabilities.
The income return on an investment, expressed as an annual percentage.
The ease with which an asset can be converted into cash without affecting its price.

verbs.desc: Verbes du registre académique et professionnel (C1-C2).

cards.d: To make something less severe, harmful, or painful.
To confirm or give support to a statement or finding.
To describe or portray something precisely.
To prevent something from happening; to make impossible.
A warning or qualification, often to prevent misinterpretation.
A subtle difference in meaning, expression, or shade.
A typical example or model of something; a framework of thought.
